sources.title: mnemonic: AI memory that lives in your repo
sources.snippet: Your AI assistant remembers your projects. mnemonic is a local MCP server that stores memories as plain markdown in git. Project-scoped hybrid recall finds concepts, exact names, identifiers, and connected context. No database. No always-on service.

sources.title: MnemonicAI — Aria, the AI that remembers you
sources.snippet: Memory-native AI · private by design Most AI forgets you the moment you close the tab. Aria doesn't. She remembers what you tell her — your projects, your preferences, the way you think — and gets more useful every time you talk. Private to you, always. Meet the assistant that actually grows with you.
